name: Tyler Nguyen

resumeText: I am a QA Automation Engineer at Foundry Labs where I write Selenium-based browser tests in JavaScript for our fleet-management dashboard. I moved from manual QA testing at Portside Logistics into automation, and in the past year I have built a growing regression suite using Mocha and Node.js. I also use Cypress for focused component flows. My main growth areas are wiring the suites into CI/CD and automating API-level coverage, which I currently handle manually with Jira and TestRail tracking.
